{{Current events|year=2026|month=03|day=2|content=

<!-- All news items below this line --> 
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on the United Arab Emirates]]
****[[Dubai International Airport]] resumes limited flights for stranded international passengers, with the first flights cleared to depart [[Dubai]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/02/middle-east-flights.html (CNBC)]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Cyprus]]
****[[President of Cyprus|Cypriot president]] [[Nikos Christodoulides]] confirms that an Iranian drone struck the [[British Armed Forces|British]] base [[RAF Akrotiri]] last night. [[Paphos International Airport]] is evacuated after a "drone threat", while [[Greece]] deploys two frigates and [[General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon|F-16 fighter jets]] to [[Cyprus]] amid rising tensions. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cm2r0q310e3o (BBC)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/cyprus-airport-evacuated-after-radar-detects-suspect-object-2026-03-02/ (Reuters)] [https://www.ekathimerini.com/politics/foreign-policy/1296727/greece-deploys-frigates-and-f-16s-to-cyprus-amid-rising-security-tensions/ (''Ekathimerini'')]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Kuwait]]
****Two [[Kuwait Naval Force|Kuwaiti navy]] members are killed amid Iranian attacks, according to the [[Ministry of Defense (Kuwait)|Kuwaiti defence ministry]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/kuwait-says-one-of-its-naval-soldiers-killed-in-military-operation/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
****Iranian drones strike the [[Embassy of the United States, Kuwait City|U.S. embassy]] in [[Kuwait City]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/iran-israel-war-clouds-of-smoke-seen-rising-from-us-embassy-in-kuwait-11157243 (AFP via NDTV)]
***[[Reactions to the 2026 Iran conflict]]
****[[Secretary General of NATO|NATO secretary general]] [[Mark Rutte]] states that [[NATO]] has no plans to be involved in the conflict, while praising [[Israel]] and the [[United States]] for their strikes against [[Iran]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/natos-rutte-praises-us-israeli-military-action-against-iran-says-alliance-wont-2026-03-02/ (Reuters)]
***The [[United States]] [[United States Central Command|Central Command]] (CENTCOM) reports three more [[United States Army|U.S. soldier]]s have been [[killed in action|killed]], bringing the death toll among U.S. forces to six, since the start of the conflict with Iran. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/centcom-says-2-more-us-servicemembers-killed-in-iran-fighting-raising-death-toll-to-6/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-us-war-day-3-american-deaths-israel-gulf-allies-hit-missile-strikes/ (CBS News)]
***Iran launches a missile and [[Drone warfare|drone attack]] on [[Saudi Aramco]]'s [[oil refinery]] in [[Ras Tanura]], [[Saudi Arabia]], causing several large fires at the facility, and forcing its closure by Saudi authorities. [https://caspianpost.com/iran/iran-launches-missile-and-drone-strikes-on-saudi-aramco-oil-complex-video (''The Caspian Post'')]
***Three [[United States Air Force|U.S. Air Force]] [[McDonnell Douglas F-15E Strike Eagle|F-15E fighter jets]] crash in [[Kuwait]] during combat operations against Iran after being mistakenly shot down by the [[Kuwait Armed Forces|Kuwaiti military]]. All crew members survive. The U.S. CENTCOM confirms the loss of the three aircraft in a [[friendly fire]] incident. [https://abcnews4.com/news/nation-world/3-us-fighter-jets-f15e-strike-eagles-mistakenly-shot-down-by-kuwait-air-defenses-during-iran-attacks-operation-epic-fury-central-command-friendly-fire?teaserSource=trending (ABC4 News)]  [https://edition.cnn.com/2026/03/02/middleeast/us-kuwait-aircraft-crash-iran-intl-hnk (CNN)] [https://www.turkiyetoday.com/region/us-f-15-crashes-in-kuwait-3215419?s=1 (Turkiye Today)]
***U.S. Air Force [[Rockwell B-1 Lancer|B-1 Lancer]] [[strategic bomber]]s carry out strikes targeting above-ground [[ballistic missile]] launch sites and [[command and control]] centres in Iran. [https://www.devdiscourse.com/article/headlines/3823533-us-air-forces-overnight-strategic-strikes-in-iran (Devdiscourse)]
***The [[Qatar Emiri Air Force|Qatari air force]] says it shot down two [[Islamic Republic of Iran Air Force|Iranian]] [[Sukhoi Su-24|Su-24]] jets over the [[Persian Gulf]]. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-israel-us-03-02-2026-cb42936de1d8c261be8f30f11c6665fa (AP)]
***The [[U.S. military]] says it has struck [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy|IRGC Navy]] [[drone carrier]] [[IRIS Shahid Bagheri|IRIS ''Shahid Bagheri'']]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/us-says-it-struck-iranian-naval-drone-carrier-during-the-opening-strikes-on-saturday/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)|Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]
***[[2026 Hezbollah–Israel strikes]]
****As a response to [[2026 Israeli–United States strikes on Iran|Israel's attacks against Iran]] and [[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon|Israel's occupation of parts of Lebanon]], [[Hezbollah]] fired two projectiles targeting an Israeli military base near [[Haifa]]. [[Israel]] then responded with attacks in [[Beirut]] and across many villages in [[Lebanon]]. At least 52 people are killed and 149 more are injured. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/2/israel-bombs-beirut-after-hezbollah-launches-rocket-attack (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cy0dp1l57nxt (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/lebanese-prime-minister-says-lebanon-will-ban-hezbollahs-military-activities-2026-03-02/ (Reuters)]
****[[Prime Minister of Lebanon|Lebanese prime minister]] [[Nawaf Salam]] bans Hezbollah’s military activities following an attack on Israel. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/2/lebanese-pm-nawaf-salam-announces-ban-on-hezbollah-military-activities (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] drones strike an [[oil terminal]] in the [[Russia|Russian]] port city of [[Novorossiysk]], [[Krasnodar Krai]]. Four residential buildings in the area are reportedly damaged in the attack. [https://kyivindependent.com/ukrainian-drones-reportedly-strike-novorossiysk-oil-terminal-in-southern-russia/ (''Kyiv Independent'')]
*[[2026 Afghanistan–Pakistan war]]
**The [[Taliban]] says the [[Afghan Armed Forces|Afghan military]] has successfully repelled [[Pakistan Air Force|Pakistani]] warplanes with [[surface-to-air missile]]s that were attacking [[Bagram Airfield]] as explosions are reported in several cities, including [[Kabul]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/mar/02/afghanistan-pakistan-airstrikes-bagram-airbase (''The Guardian'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[2026 Iran conflict]]
**Iranian semi-official news agency [[Mehr News Agency]] reports that the former royal residence and [[UNESCO World Heritage Site]] [[Golestan Palace]] is damaged by an airstrike. [https://wanaen.com/airstrike-on-tehran-damages-golestan-palace-unesco-world-heritage-site/ (WANA)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Qatar]]i-state owned [[QatarEnergy]] halts all [[Liquefied natural gas|LNG]] production at its [[Ras Laffan Industrial City]] following an Iranian drone attack. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-03-02/qatar-stops-lng-production-at-world-s-top-plant-after-attack (''Bloomberg News'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A floor collapses in an under-construction building in [[Johannesburg]], [[South Africa]], killing nine people. [https://apnews.com/article/south-africa-building-collapse-death-toll-e77eca4f3e7df2d1cdaf6ba12f1b7ed5 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)]]
**[[Save the Children]] announces that [[vaccine]]s have arrived in the [[Sudan|Sudanese]] [[States of Sudan|state]] of [[South Kordofan]], their first in three years since the civil war broke out. [https://sudantribune.com/article/311303 (''Sudan Tribune'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Canada–India relations]]
**[[Canada|Canadian]] [[Prime Minister of Canada|prime minister]] [[Mark Carney]] and [[India]]n [[Prime Minister of India|prime minister]] [[Narendra Modi]] agree to a deal that would strengthen their economic partnership, aimed at boosting ties after two years of strained relationship between the two countries. [https://apnews.com/article/india-canada-trade-modi-carney-632cf32892560ab18a72e67f39df6c15 (AP)]
*[[France and weapons of mass destruction]]
**[[President of France|French president]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] announces that [[France]] will increase its stockpile of [[nuclear weapons]] for the first time in decades citing global threats such as [[Russia]]'s [[Russo-Ukrainian war|war on Ukraine]], [[China]]'s growing [[People's Liberation Army|military]] power in [[Asia]], and changing U.S. defense priorities as reasons for the nuclear build-up. [https://www.politico.eu/article/macron-announces-increase-in-number-of-frances-nuclear-warheads/ (Politico)]
**[[Denmark]] and France make an agreement on [[Deterrence theory#Nuclear deterrence theory|strategic nuclear deterrence]]. However, French nuclear weapons are not to be located on Danish territory. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/denmark-cooperate-with-france-nuclear-deterrence-2026-03-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[Rwanda–United States relations]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict (2022–present)|Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict]]
**The [[United States Department of State|U.S. Department of State]] imposes [[United States government sanctions|sanctions]] on the [[Rwanda]]n [[Rwandan Defence Force|military]] for allegedly supporting the [[March 23 Movement]] and violating [[2025 DRC–Rwanda peace agreement|a peace agreement]] with the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/us-slaps-sanctions-on-rwanda-military-over-dr-congo-violation-a34fa4ba (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*[[Spain–United States relations]]
**U.S. military aircraft begin to leave [[Spain]] after the [[Government of Spain|Spanish government]] denied the U.S. permission to use their airbases for [[military operation]]s against Iran. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-aircraft-leave-spain-after-government-says-bases-cannot-be-used-iran-attacks-2026-03-02/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2026 Winter Paralympics]]
**[[Belarus at the 2026 Winter Paralympics]], [[Russia at the 2026 Winter Paralympics]]
***[[Lithuania]]n broadcaster [[Lithuanian National Radio and Television]] says it will not air the opening ceremony of the upcoming [[Winter Paralympic Games|Winter Paralympics]], citing the participation of athletes from [[Belarus]] and [[Russia]]. [https://www.lrt.lt/en/news-in-english/19/2855412/lrt-to-boycott-paralympics-opening-ceremony-over-russian-belarusian-participation (LRT)]
